title: MELD: A Protocol for Merging Knowledge Across Distributed Agentic Memories -- reference implementation and experiments
description: Reference implementation, experiment drivers and study archive for MELD, a knowledge-merge protocol for sovereign agent memories. Replicas exchange only what principals assert, as five replicated grow-only sets (signed claim deltas, authored status effects, recorded NLI evidence, calibration records and calibration epochs), and derive consolidation, representatives and typed links by a deterministic fold that emits a recomputable certificate per pass. Admission is risk-specified: a tolerated false-merge rate is turned into a threshold per store-size bin by split-conformal calibration on labelled tested pairs, with abstention to RELATE and signed recalibration epochs. Includes the protocol and fold, the conformal calibration and epoch tooling, the benchmark builder for naturalistic pairs from PAWS, SICK, VitaminC, LongMemEval and SciFact, the Mem0, Graphiti and Caura merge-policy baselines, the convergence, recalibration, independently-evolving-memory, cross-hardware and scale drivers, the multi-host testbed drivers, and a study archive (release/study-archive) with result rows and provenance stamps, group-signed epochs and calibration records, and annotation and audit records. Version 2.0.0 accompanies the TAAS manuscript.
